Name: Micro Farmhouse
Author: idermailer
Description:
[size=4][b]What does this mod do?[/b][/size]
Replaces the Farmhouse map and removes several farmhouse renovations. The starting furniture and gift box positions have been adjusted.
The basement won't cramped.

NOTE: If you have loaded a save that has [u]any of the Open Bedroom, Add Southern Room, Add Cubby, Add Attic, or Expand Corner Room[/u] renovations applied, [u]do not save[/u]. The fact that you have renovationed it can disappear.
Note2: The two rooms on the left are being added through renovation.
Note3: This mod can be disabled, without deletion

[size=4][b]Why are you uploading it even though it is incomplete?[/b][/size]
This is because I have modified all the parts that can be modified with CP and that will not cause errors. And I'm not sure if I can come up with a C# mode that would prevent that error from occurring.

[size=4][b]Mods that are good to install together:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8808]Infinite Zoom[/url]
